concerns.text: Spec FR-011 mandates a DeLong's test comparing the model against a clinical covariates-only baseline. While tasks T039a (Baseline Model Training) and T039b (Clinical Covariate Extraction) exist, they are marked incomplete (`- [ ]`). Furthermore, the specific DeLong implementation tasks (T039_1_1, T039_1_2) and the Bonferroni application for DeLong (T039_2) are also incomplete. Without these tasks being marked as actionable/complete, the FR-011 requirement cannot be satisfied.

Spec FR-012 and SC-004/SC-005 mandate execution within strict CPU/RAM limits (≤6h, ≤7GB). Tasks T005a (Resource Detection) and T005b (Docker Enforcement) are marked incomplete (`- [ ]`). These tasks are critical for enforcing the resource constraints required by the spec. Their incomplete status means the pipeline lacks the mechanism to satisfy FR-012.

Spec FR-008 requires a Leave-One-Cancer-Type-Out (LOO) validation that halts if <2 tumor types remain. The Plan explicitly resolves this into a 'LOO Loop Controller' task. Task T035a ('Implement LOO Loop Controller') is marked incomplete (`- [ ]`) and lacks the explicit state management logic (writing `results/loo_state.json`) described in the Plan's resolution. This leaves the critical FR-008 validation flow unimplemented.

Task T005a references 'Smith et al. (2023),' with a trailing comma and no full citation details in the task description. While the logic is described, the citation format is malformed and incomplete, which may hinder traceability to the specific method for dynamic capping.
